title: n8n in an hour
summary: Connect two services with a workflow in n8n and know the words around it.

lessons.title: What n8n is and how the editor works

blocks.text: n8n is a tool that runs **workflows**. A workflow is a chain of nodes: a trigger starts it and other nodes do the work.

items: An **action** does something, like sending a mail
Data flows from node to node as items
Open the editor and add a trigger.
Add an action node after it.
Run the workflow and read the output.

blocks.label: What you already know from Laravel
blocks.text: A workflow is like a queued job chain, drawn on a canvas.

blocks.label: Say it like this in an interview
blocks.text: I used n8n to connect services without writing glue code, and read the [n8n docs](https://docs.n8n.io/) for the details.

deeper.text: Picture a row of dominoes. The trigger is the first one you push.
Every node after it falls because the one before it fell.

blocks.text: Each node gets items from the node before it. You pick a field with an expression such as `{{ $json.email }}`.

blocks.label: What you already know from Laravel
blocks.text: An expression reads a field of the current item, like `$request->email`.

blocks.label: Say it like this in an interview
blocks.text: I map fields from one node to the next with expressions.

check.question: How do you read the email field of the current item?

deeper.text: An item is a form that is passed down a desk. Each desk reads the boxes it needs.
An expression tells the desk which box to read.

exercise.title: Mail a new sign-up
exercise.intro: Send yourself a message when a form is submitted.
steps: Add a node that sends an email.
Use an expression for the name.

solution.text: The webhook gives the item, the mail node reads `{{ $json.name }}`.

quiz.question: What is one piece of data in n8n called?
Which node type starts a workflow?
Which expression reads the email field?
